## Review checklist

- [ ] Targets `main` from a dedicated issue branch.
- [ ] Contains only changes needed for the linked issue.
- [ ] Includes relevant tests or explains why none are needed.
- [ ] Records validation results and any limitations.
- [ ] Updates relevant documentation and issue/PR notes.
- [ ] Excludes local databases, installers, caches, and secrets.

## Review and merge

Senior Engineer Codex reviews independently. Feedback and re-review happen in the Codex conversation; once satisfied, the reviewer posts exactly one final ordinary GitHub comment stating `APPROVED FOR MERGE`. This is not an official GitHub approval. No intermediate review comments are posted on GitHub. The Senior Engineer never merges; merging requires user authorization.
